    Profile

    Uzuma is a renowned fortune-teller from a desert region. She's physically weak, and very clumsy, but possesses the ability to see into people's futures. Before she understood her powers properly, she would voice all her premonitions immediately—including people's forthcoming deaths—and as a result she was feared by those around her.

    Origin: Desert Zone
    Gender: Female
    Height: 168cm
    Weight: 48kg
    Birthday: Aug 9
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Swift Sails
    Likes: Fluffy flower heads
    Hobbies: Long baths
    Illust: keypot
    CV: 原田彩楓
